newsitem.title: USA: First Alliance, Central & Southern to merge.
newsitem.headline: First Alliance, Central & Southern to merge.

text.p: First Alliance Premier Bancshares Inc and Central and Southern Holding Co said they agreed to merge in a stock-swap transaction valued at about $48 million.

The new company, called Premier Bancshares Inc., will have combined assets of $490 million, the companies said. The company will be 54 percent owned by First Alliance shareholders and 46 percent owned by Central and Southern shareholders.
Under terms of the transaction, First Alliance will split its stock on a 1.8-for-one basis before the deal.
After the split, the companies will swap their shares on a one-for-one basis, the companies said.
